class.name: Executable
class.description: Describes a program that is executed on a host with some commandline options.

attribute.name: Host
attribute.description: name on the host on which to execute the program (via PMG).

attribute.name: Parameters
attribute.description: command line options

attribute.name: InitTimeout
attribute.description: Timeout in seconds to get the PMG callback that the process is running

relationship.name: Executes
relationship.description: Link to the program that is going to be executed.

relationship.name: InitDependsOn
relationship.description: Program that shall reach the running state before this one is started.

attribute.name: Interactive
attribute.description: If set to true, the test is considered an interactive test and is not used by the Test Manager.

relationship.name: Runs
relationship.description: List of executables to run to perform this test.

class.name: Test
class.description: Describes a Test, its implementation, dependencies and outcomes.

attribute.name: Timeout
attribute.description: Timeout in seconds for test execution

attribute.name: Scope
attribute.description: Defines the context in which the test execution is allowed. Tests with the "any" scope set are always executed.

attribute.name: Complexity
attribute.description: Define level of complexity of test. When testing of a component is requested with the level specified, only those tests with a complexity <= the specified level are executed. If no specific level is requested, all tests are executed.

attribute.name: Validity
attribute.description: Amount of seconds during which a test result is valid. This attribute is used by hte TM client library to avoid useless repetition of tests.

attribute.name: RepeatIfUnresolved
attribute.description: If set to true a test which results in and UNRESOLVED code will be automatically repeated before passing the result to the requestor.

relationship.name: ExecDependsOnSuccess
relationship.description: The test will only be executed once the tests listed in this relationship will have run successfully.

relationship.name: ExecDependsOnFailure
relationship.description: The test will only be executed once the tests listed in this relationship will have failed.

relationship.name: Failures
relationship.description: Describes how the test can fail. If this relation is left empty, a test failure will not provide any hint on how to understand/debug/fix the problem.

attribute.name: ServantName
attribute.description: Name with which the servant is registered in IPC.

attribute.name: ServantType
attribute.description: Type with which the servant is registered in IPC.

attribute.name: ClassName
attribute.description: Class of components to which this test applies to.

attribute.name: CPartitionName
attribute.description: Partition in which the Corba Servants are.

class.name: Test4Class
class.description: Describes tests which are applied for all instances of a particular class in the configuration.

attribute.name: ClassName
attribute.description: Class name from the databse. The test tests all objects of this class.

class.name: Test4Object
class.description: Describes tests which are applied to a set of specific objects in the configuration.

attribute.name: OverrideTest4Class
attribute.description: Both Test4Class and Test4Object can be defined for an object in database. If this attribute set ti 'true', Test4Object overrides Test4Class (this is default behaviour). Otherwise it is appended to the list of tests defined for this object via Test4Class.

relationship.name: Objects
relationship.description: References all database objects testable by this Test. Objects must belong to classes inherited from TestableObject.

class.name: TestBehavior
class.description: This class describes the behavior to adopt when testing a set of objects belonging to the same relationship of a class. Objects linked via this relationship will be tested according to the specified behavior.

attribute.name: RelationshipName
attribute.description: Name of the Relationship to be followed in a class.

attribute.name: SynchronousTesting
attribute.description: Defines whether object should be tested synchronously or in parallel.

attribute.name: StopOnError
attribute.description: Determines whether at the first failing test the test sequence shall be interrupted

attribute.name: IgnoreClasses
attribute.description: Object castable to these classes will not be loaded when following this relationship

class.name: TestFailure
class.description: Describes a specific failure mode for a Test. The expert can add diagnostics text and follow up actions that may be performed by the operator or automatic recovery system.

attribute.name: ReturnCode
attribute.description: Return code of the test associate to the failure consequence. Unix ReturnCodes are integers between 0 and 255.

attribute.name: diagnosis
attribute.description: Textual description of the failure that may help the operator.

relationship.name: Actions
relationship.description: List of actions to be performed upon specific failure of a certain test.

class.name: TestFailureAction
class.description: A recovery action which follows an Failure, to be performed automatically by DVS (test action) or CHIP (reboot, restart) action-

attribute.name: action
attribute.description: Action (e.g. a recovery or an additional test) to be performed by a client upon certain test failure.

attribute.name: parameters
attribute.description: A formatted string of parameters for the action. E.g. "computer=#this.RunsOn;scope=diagnostics". Parameters are to be parsed by the client.

attribute.name: timeout
attribute.description: Timeout in seconds for the action to be executed and further actions like test to be performed.

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: Just a description of an action, to be displayed to a user.

relationship.name: Runs
relationship.description: List of Executables which are to be launched for an FailureAction - makes sense for 'exec' type of action only.

class.name: TestPolicy
class.description: This class allows a user to define the dependencies among related components for the purpose of testing.

attribute.name: SynchronousTesting
attribute.description: Specifies whether the relations should be tested one after the other or in parallel.

attribute.name: StopOnError
attribute.description: Determines whether the test sequence should be interrupted if a test fails.

attribute.name: TestOfContainer
attribute.description: Whether the object for which the policy is described should be tested before or after the objects it refers to.

relationship.name: RelationsSequence
relationship.description: Defines the order in which relationships must be followed for the purpose of testing.

attribute.name: Class
attribute.description: Name of the class for which a test policy is defined

relationship.name: Objects
relationship.description: Objects to which this test policy applies.

class.name: TestSet
class.description: for grouping of tests for archiving purposes

relationship.name: tests
relationship.description: just a group of tests, for archiving purposes

relationship.name: TestPolicies
relationship.description: Policies defined for this test repository.
